client_identity.display_note: MQTTium Paho VERSION2 compatibility façade only (mqttium.compat.paho) — ranked separately from native `mqttium`.

private_api.AsyncClient._engine / _engine_lock / _su: subscribe registration mirrored from AsyncClient.subscribe: the façade has no on_subscribe hook to deliver grants
private_api.AsyncClient._max_outbound_bytes: façade ctor has no max_outbound_bytes; the 1 MiB write-pump default would bind payload sweeps unless sized from bench max_queued_bytes
private_api.AsyncClient._reconfigure: loop-confined config boundary used to set keepalive before TLS connect
private_api.Client._async: TLS connect passes SSLContext to the inner client (public connect() does not) and the write-pump byte bound is sized on it
private_api.Client._loop: needed to schedule the properties publish path on the façade's own loop
private_api.Client._run_loop_mutation: applies the bench keepalive on the façade's loop before a TLS connect
private_api.Client._submit: TLS connect must pass an SSLContext, which the façade's own connect() does not accept
